matnlar.en: The Statue of Liberty stands in New York Harbor. It was a gift from France in 1886.
matnlar.uz: Ozodlik haykali Nyu-York bandargohida turibdi. U 1886-yilda Fransiyaning sovg'asi bo'lgan.

matnlar.en: The statue holds a torch in her right hand. With the base, she is 93 metres tall.
matnlar.uz: Haykal o'ng qo'lida mash'al ushlab turibdi. Poydevori bilan birga uning balandligi 93 metr.

matnlar.en: The statue is made of copper. It was brown at first, but now it is green.
matnlar.uz: Haykal misdan yasalgan. Avval u jigarrang edi, hozir esa yashil.

matnlar.en: Big Ben is the famous clock tower in London. Its bell rings every hour.
matnlar.uz: Big Ben — Londondagi mashhur soat minorasi. Uning qo'ng'irog'i har soatda chalinadi.

matnlar.en: Big Ben is really the name of the bell, not the tower. The tower is called the Elizabeth Tower.
matnlar.uz: Aslida Big Ben — minora emas, qo'ng'iroqning nomi. Minora Yelizaveta minorasi deb ataladi.

matnlar.en: The tower is 96 metres tall. There are 334 steps to the top.
matnlar.uz: Minoraning balandligi 96 metr. Uning tepasiga 334 ta zina bor.

matnlar.en: The Grand Canyon is in Arizona. It is about 1.8 kilometres deep.
matnlar.uz: Buyuk kanyon Arizona shtatida joylashgan. Uning chuqurligi taxminan 1,8 kilometr.

matnlar.en: The Colorado River made the canyon over millions of years.
matnlar.uz: Kanyonni millionlab yillar davomida Kolorado daryosi hosil qilgan.

matnlar.en: The canyon is about 446 kilometres long.
matnlar.uz: Kanyonning uzunligi taxminan 446 kilometr.

matnlar.en: Tower Bridge crosses the River Thames in London. The middle of the bridge can open for big ships.
matnlar.uz: Tauer ko'prigi Londonda Temza daryosi ustidan o'tadi. Katta kemalar uchun ko'prikning o'rtasi ochiladi.

matnlar.en: Tower Bridge opened in 1894.
matnlar.uz: Tauer ko'prigi 1894-yilda ochilgan.

matnlar.en: There is a glass floor at the top of the bridge. You can look down at the river and the cars.
matnlar.uz: Ko'prik tepasida shisha pol bor. Undan pastdagi daryo va mashinalarga qarash mumkin.

matnlar.en: The Golden Gate Bridge is in San Francisco. Its colour is called "international orange".
matnlar.uz: Oltin darvoza ko'prigi San-Fransiskoda joylashgan. Uning rangi «xalqaro to'q sariq» deb ataladi.

matnlar.en: The bridge opened in 1937. It is about 2.7 kilometres long.
matnlar.uz: Ko'prik 1937-yilda ochilgan. Uning uzunligi taxminan 2,7 kilometr.

matnlar.en: In the morning there is often fog around the bridge.
matnlar.uz: Ertalab ko'prik atrofida ko'pincha tuman bo'ladi.

matnlar.en: Stonehenge is a circle of huge stones in England. People built it about 5,000 years ago.
matnlar.uz: Stounhenj — Angliyadagi ulkan toshlardan iborat aylana. Odamlar uni taxminan 5000 yil oldin qurishgan.

matnlar.en: Some of the stones came from Wales, more than 200 kilometres away.
matnlar.uz: Ba'zi toshlar 200 kilometrdan ham uzoqroqdagi Uelsdan keltirilgan.

matnlar.en: Every summer, many people come here to watch the sunrise on the longest day of the year.
matnlar.uz: Har yozda ko'p odamlar yilning eng uzun kunida quyosh chiqishini ko'rish uchun bu yerga kelishadi.

matnlar.en: Times Square is in the centre of New York. It is full of bright lights day and night.
matnlar.uz: Tayms-skver Nyu-York markazida joylashgan. U kechayu kunduz yorqin chiroqlarga to'la.

matnlar.en: On New Year's Eve, a big ball comes down here at midnight.
matnlar.uz: Yangi yil kechasi bu yerda yarim tunda katta shar pastga tushadi.

matnlar.en: Many Broadway theatres are near Times Square.
matnlar.uz: Tayms-skver yaqinida Brodveyning ko'plab teatrlari bor.

matnlar.en: Edinburgh Castle stands on an old volcanic rock. It is the most famous place in Scotland.
matnlar.uz: Edinburg qal'asi qadimgi vulqon qoyasi ustida turibdi. Bu Shotlandiyadagi eng mashhur joy.

matnlar.en: Every day except Sunday, a cannon fires from the castle at one o'clock.
matnlar.uz: Yakshanbadan boshqa har kuni soat birda qal'adan to'p otiladi.

matnlar.en: Every August, Edinburgh has a big festival of music and theatre.
matnlar.uz: Har avgustda Edinburgda musiqa va teatrning katta festivali bo'ladi.

matnlar.en: Niagara Falls is on the border of the USA and Canada. Millions of tourists visit it every year.
matnlar.uz: Niagara sharsharasi AQSh va Kanada chegarasida joylashgan. Uni har yili millionlab sayyohlar ko'radi.

matnlar.en: Niagara Falls is really three waterfalls together.
matnlar.uz: Niagara aslida uchta sharsharadan iborat.

matnlar.en: Tourists can take a boat very close to the falls.
matnlar.uz: Sayyohlar qayiqda sharsharaga juda yaqin borishlari mumkin.

matnlar.en: Buckingham Palace is the home of the British king in London. It has 775 rooms.
matnlar.uz: Bukingem saroyi — Britaniya qirolining Londondagi qarorgohi. Unda 775 ta xona bor.

matnlar.en: When the Royal Standard flag flies over the palace, the king is at home.
matnlar.uz: Saroy ustida qirollik bayrog'i hilpirab tursa, qirol saroyda bo'ladi.

matnlar.en: Visitors love to watch the Changing of the Guard in front of the palace.
matnlar.uz: Mehmonlar saroy oldidagi soqchilar almashinuvini tomosha qilishni yaxshi ko'rishadi.

matnlar.en: The Capitol is in Washington, D.C. The US Congress works in this building.
matnlar.uz: Kapitoliy Vashingtonda joylashgan. AQSh Kongressi shu binoda ishlaydi.

matnlar.en: The building has a big white dome. It stands on a hill called Capitol Hill.
matnlar.uz: Binoning katta oq gumbazi bor. U Kapitoliy tepaligi deb ataladigan tepalikda turibdi.

matnlar.en: On top of the dome there is a statue called the Statue of Freedom.
matnlar.uz: Gumbaz tepasida Erkinlik haykali deb ataladigan haykal turibdi.

matnlar.en: The London Eye is a giant wheel next to the River Thames. From the top you can see all of London.
matnlar.uz: London ko'zi — Temza daryosi yonidagi ulkan charxpalak. Uning tepasidan butun London ko'rinadi.

matnlar.en: The London Eye is 135 metres tall. One trip takes about 30 minutes.
matnlar.uz: London ko'zining balandligi 135 metr. Bir aylanish taxminan 30 daqiqa davom etadi.

matnlar.en: It opened in 2000. It has 32 glass capsules.
matnlar.uz: U 2000-yilda ochilgan. Unda 32 ta shisha kabina bor.

matnlar.en: Yellowstone was the first national park in the world. It has hot springs and geysers.
matnlar.uz: Yelloustoun dunyodagi birinchi milliy bog' bo'lgan. Unda issiq buloqlar va geyzerlar bor.

matnlar.en: The geyser Old Faithful shoots hot water into the air many times a day.
matnlar.uz: Old Feytful geyzeri kuniga ko'p marta havoga issiq suv otib chiqaradi.

matnlar.en: Bears, wolves and bison live in Yellowstone.
matnlar.uz: Yelloustounda ayiqlar, bo'rilar va bizonlar yashaydi.

matnlar.en: Oxford is home to the oldest university in the English-speaking world. Students have studied here for more than 900 years.
matnlar.uz: Oksfordda ingliz tilida so'zlashuvchi dunyodagi eng qadimgi universitet bor. Bu yerda 900 yildan ortiq vaqtdan beri talabalar o'qiydi.

matnlar.en: Some scenes from the Harry Potter films were filmed in Oxford.
matnlar.uz: «Garri Potter» filmlarining ba'zi sahnalari Oksfordda suratga olingan.

matnlar.en: People call Oxford "the city of dreaming spires".
matnlar.uz: Oksfordni «orzu qiluvchi minoralar shahri» deb atashadi.

matnlar.en: Four US presidents are carved into the rock of Mount Rushmore. Each face is about 18 metres tall.
matnlar.uz: Rashmor tog'i qoyasiga to'rtta AQSh prezidentining yuzi o'yib ishlangan. Har bir yuzning balandligi taxminan 18 metr.

matnlar.en: The faces are of Washington, Jefferson, Theodore Roosevelt and Lincoln.
matnlar.uz: Yuzlar Vashington, Jefferson, Teodor Ruzvelt va Linkolnga tegishli.

matnlar.en: About 400 workers made the monument between 1927 and 1941.
matnlar.uz: Monumentni 1927–1941-yillarda 400 ga yaqin ishchi yasagan.

matnlar.en: The Lake District is in the north of England. It is famous for its lakes, hills and walking paths.
matnlar.uz: Ko'llar o'lkasi Angliyaning shimolida joylashgan. U ko'llari, tepaliklari va piyoda yo'laklari bilan mashhur.

matnlar.en: England's highest mountain, Scafell Pike, is in the Lake District.
matnlar.uz: Angliyaning eng baland tog'i — Skofell-Payk Ko'llar o'lkasida joylashgan.

matnlar.en: The writer Beatrix Potter lived here. She wrote stories about Peter Rabbit.
matnlar.uz: Bu yerda yozuvchi Beatris Potter yashagan. U Piter quyon haqida ertaklar yozgan.

matnlar.en: Chicago is a big city on Lake Michigan. The first skyscraper in the world was built here.
matnlar.uz: Chikago — Michigan ko'li bo'yidagi katta shahar. Dunyodagi birinchi osmono'par bino shu yerda qurilgan.

matnlar.en: People call Chicago "the Windy City".
matnlar.uz: Chikagoni «Shamolli shahar» deb atashadi.

matnlar.en: Every year on St Patrick's Day, the Chicago River turns green.
matnlar.uz: Har yili Avliyo Patrik kuni Chikago daryosi yashil rangga bo'yaladi.

matnlar.en: The Isle of Skye is an island in Scotland. It has wild mountains and beautiful sea views.
matnlar.uz: Skay oroli — Shotlandiyadagi orol. Unda yovvoyi tog'lar va chiroyli dengiz manzaralari bor.

matnlar.en: A bridge connects the Isle of Skye to the mainland.
matnlar.uz: Skay orolini quruqlik bilan ko'prik bog'laydi.

matnlar.en: The Old Man of Storr is a tall rock on the island. Many people walk up to see it.
matnlar.uz: Storr choli — oroldagi baland qoya. Ko'p odamlar uni ko'rish uchun tepaga chiqishadi.

matnlar.en: Yosemite is a national park in California. It is famous for its giant rocks and waterfalls.
matnlar.uz: Yosemiti — Kaliforniyadagi milliy bog'. U ulkan qoyalari va sharsharalari bilan mashhur.

matnlar.en: Half Dome is a famous rock in Yosemite. It looks like half of a ball.
matnlar.uz: Half Doum — Yosemitidagi mashhur qoya. U yarimta sharga o'xshaydi.

matnlar.en: Giant sequoia trees grow here. They are some of the biggest trees in the world.
matnlar.uz: Bu yerda ulkan sekvoyalar o'sadi. Ular dunyodagi eng katta daraxtlar qatoriga kiradi.

matnlar.en: Windsor Castle is the oldest castle in the world where people still live. The royal family often stays here.
matnlar.uz: Vindzor qal'asi — hali ham odamlar yashaydigan dunyodagi eng qadimgi qal'a. Qirollik oilasi bu yerda tez-tez bo'ladi.

matnlar.en: Windsor Castle is near London. It is more than 900 years old.
matnlar.uz: Vindzor qal'asi London yaqinida joylashgan. Uning yoshi 900 yildan oshgan.

matnlar.en: Inside the castle there is a famous doll's house made for Queen Mary.
matnlar.uz: Qal'a ichida qirolicha Meri uchun yasalgan mashhur qo'g'irchoq uyi bor.

matnlar.en: Monument Valley has tall red rocks in the desert. You can see it in many Western films.
matnlar.uz: Monument vodiysida cho'l o'rtasida baland qizil qoyalar bor. Uni ko'plab vestern filmlarida ko'rish mumkin.

matnlar.en: Monument Valley is on Navajo land, on the border of Arizona and Utah.
matnlar.uz: Monument vodiysi Arizona va Yuta chegarasida, navaxo xalqi yerida joylashgan.

matnlar.en: The rocks look red because there is iron in them.
matnlar.uz: Qoyalar qizil ko'rinadi, chunki ularda temir bor.

matnlar.en: Cambridge is a famous university city. Students often go boating on the river here.
matnlar.uz: Kembrij — mashhur universitet shahri. Bu yerda talabalar ko'pincha daryoda qayiqda suzishadi.

matnlar.en: The University of Cambridge started in 1209.
matnlar.uz: Kembrij universiteti 1209-yilda tashkil topgan.

matnlar.en: Isaac Newton studied and worked in Cambridge.
matnlar.uz: Isaak Nyuton Kembrijda o'qigan va ishlagan.

matnlar.en: The Empire State Building is in New York. It has 102 floors.
matnlar.uz: Empayr-Steyt-Bilding Nyu-Yorkda joylashgan. Unda 102 ta qavat bor.

matnlar.en: The building opened in 1931. The builders finished it in only about 13 months.
matnlar.uz: Bino 1931-yilda ochilgan. Quruvchilar uni atigi 13 oyga yaqin vaqtda qurib bitkazishgan.

matnlar.en: At night, the top of the building shines in different colours.
matnlar.uz: Kechasi binoning tepasi turli ranglarda yonib turadi.

matnlar.en: Bath is a beautiful old city in England. The Romans built baths here around 2,000 years ago.
matnlar.uz: Bat — Angliyadagi chiroyli qadimiy shahar. Rimliklar bu yerda taxminan 2000 yil oldin hammomlar qurishgan.

matnlar.en: The water in the baths is hot. It comes from deep under the ground.
matnlar.uz: Hammomlardagi suv issiq. U yerning tubidan chiqadi.

matnlar.en: The writer Jane Austen lived in Bath.
matnlar.uz: Yozuvchi Jeyn Ostin Batda yashagan.

matnlar.en: Las Vegas is a city in the Nevada desert. It is famous for its big hotels and shows.
matnlar.uz: Las-Vegas — Nevada cho'lidagi shahar. U katta mehmonxonalari va shoulari bilan mashhur.

matnlar.en: The Bellagio hotel has famous fountains that dance to music.
matnlar.uz: Bellajio mehmonxonasida musiqaga mos raqsga tushadigan mashhur favvoralar bor.

matnlar.en: Las Vegas is not far from the Hoover Dam, a huge dam on the Colorado River.
matnlar.uz: Las-Vegasdan uncha uzoq bo'lmagan joyda Kolorado daryosidagi ulkan Guver to'g'oni bor.

matnlar.en: The Giant's Causeway is in Northern Ireland. It has about 40,000 stone columns made by a volcano.
matnlar.uz: Gigant yo'li Shimoliy Irlandiyada joylashgan. Unda vulqon hosil qilgan 40 mingga yaqin tosh ustun bor.

matnlar.en: An old story says that a giant called Finn McCool built it.
matnlar.uz: Qadimiy afsonaga ko'ra, uni Finn MakKul ismli gigant qurgan.

matnlar.en: Most of the stones have six sides.
matnlar.uz: Toshlarning ko'pchiligi olti qirrali.

matnlar.en: Hawaii is a group of islands in the Pacific Ocean. People go there for the beaches and warm weather.
matnlar.uz: Gavayi — Tinch okeanidagi orollar guruhi. Odamlar u yerga plyajlar va iliq ob-havo uchun borishadi.

matnlar.en: Hawaii became the 50th US state in 1959.
matnlar.uz: Gavayi 1959-yilda AQShning 50-shtatiga aylangan.

matnlar.en: Surfing is very popular in Hawaii.
matnlar.uz: Gavayida serfing juda mashhur.

matnlar.en: Snowdon is the highest mountain in Wales. You can walk to the top or take a train.
matnlar.uz: Snoudon — Uelsdagi eng baland tog'. Uning cho'qqisiga piyoda chiqish yoki poyezdda borish mumkin.

matnlar.en: Snowdon is 1,085 metres high.
matnlar.uz: Snoudonning balandligi 1085 metr.

matnlar.en: In Welsh, the mountain is called Yr Wyddfa.
matnlar.uz: Uels tilida bu tog' Ir Uidva deb ataladi.

matnlar.en: The Hollywood Sign is on a hill in Los Angeles. Each letter is about 14 metres tall.
matnlar.uz: Gollivud yozuvi Los-Anjelesdagi tepalikda turibdi. Har bir harfning balandligi taxminan 14 metr.

matnlar.en: The sign first went up in 1923. At first it said "Hollywoodland".
matnlar.uz: Yozuv birinchi marta 1923-yilda o'rnatilgan. Avval unda «Hollywoodland» deb yozilgan edi.

matnlar.en: Hollywood is the centre of the American film industry.
matnlar.uz: Gollivud — Amerika kino sanoatining markazi.

matnlar.en: The White Cliffs of Dover look over the sea towards France. On a clear day you can see the French coast.
matnlar.uz: Duvrning oq qoyalari dengiz orqali Fransiya tomonga qaraydi. Havo ochiq kunda Fransiya qirg'og'i ko'rinadi.

matnlar.en: The cliffs are white because they are made of chalk.
matnlar.uz: Qoyalar oq, chunki ular bo'rdan tashkil topgan.

matnlar.en: The cliffs are up to 110 metres high.
matnlar.uz: Qoyalarning balandligi 110 metrgacha yetadi.
